defects.title: Zero band applied inconsistently to the maximum and to max - min
defects.trigger: getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2], [0 2 -2], 0); with the default band getQualitativeFluxStates(-1, 1e-9); and at the edge of a band that is exact in binary, getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2.5], [0.5 2.5 -2], 0.5)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-17) [5 2 -2] ({'err', '++', '--'}) for delta = 0, 5 for the default band, and [5 2 -2] for delta = 0.5 (just inside that band, getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2.5], [0.4 2.4 -2.1], 0.5) gives [-1 3 -3]): the state -1 requires max < delta (not <= delta) and the fixed states -3 and 3 require |max - min| < delta (not <= delta), so with delta = 0 they cannot occur. A difference of exactly 1e-9 is hard to produce in double precision ((2 + 1e-9) - 2 is 1.000000082740371e-09), so the edge of the fixed states is shown with delta = 0.5
defects.expected: [-1 3 -3] ({'-0', '+', '-'}), -1 and [-1 3 -3]: the documented table treats |x| <= delta, and a difference max - min within delta, as zero

notes: review follow-up T031: trigger corrected; the entry holds. Confirmed that the old second default-band element (2 against 2 + 1e-9) shows nothing: (2 + 1e-9) - 2 = 1.000000082740371e-09 > 1e-9, so state 2 is right. New trigger (R2025a, 2026-11-17): getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2], [0 2 -2], 0) -> [5 2 -2]; getQualitativeFluxStates(-1, 1e-9) (default band) -> 5; getQualitativeFluxStates([-1 2 -2.5], [0.5 2.5 -2], 0.5) (band exact in binary, max and max - min exactly at the edge) -> [5 2 -2], while [0.4 2.4 -2.1] inside the band gives [-1 3 -3]. Expected [-1 3 -3], -1 and [-1 3 -3]. No decimal pair at the default 1e-9 with a difference of exactly 1e-9 was found in double precision, hence the 0.5 band. Severity and reach unchanged.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: the -1 rule uses mx < delta, line 75, the zero rule mx <= delta; with delta = 0 a value at the threshold gets state 5 and a fixed flux never gets 3, lines 68 and 85); T031 entries reproduced by the helper, read by the lead
